mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_currency_rate (id, base_currency, quote_currency, rate, rate_date, source, cross_source, cross_status, deviation_rate, date_gap_days, checked_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{baseCurrency}, #{quoteCurrency}, #{rate}, #{rateDate}, #{source}, #{crossSource}, #{crossStatus}, #{deviationRate}, #{dateGapDays}, #{checkedAt}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE rate = VALUES(rate), source = VALUES(source), cross_source = VALUES(cross_source), cross_status = VALUES(cross_status), deviation_rate = VALUES(deviation_rate), date_gap_days = VALUES(date_gap_days), checked_at = VALUES(checked_at)
